verdict.rationale: Lago documents a dedicated AI agent platform where users 'manage billing by describing what you need in plain language' with 'no manual steps', backed by an Agent SDK and MCP server exposing billing actions to AI assistants like Claude. This directly matches natural-language command operation, though evidence is entirely vendor-authored docs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the natural-language agent actually executing commands reliably, and detail on scope/limits of supported commands.
